mesmerism.text: Add 1d10 to control rolls (does not stack).

restraint.text: Add +8 to control rolls (does not stack).

correspondence.name: Lunar Society Correspondence
correspondence.text: Add 1d8 to Humanity for each rival attempting a resurrection this round.

hounds.name: Bloodhounds
hounds.text: You may subdue rivals' monsters without a garrison.

transfusion.name: Transfusion of Animal Blood
transfusion.text: Add 1d6 to Vitality. Your monsters are 2 harder to subdue for each rival able to subdue them, beyond the first.

arctic.name: Arctic Pursuit
arctic.text: Once per game, when a monster would be unleashed, make one more control roll against it.

benefactor.name: Parish Benefactor
benefactor.text: Your charity removes 1 more suspicion per unit.
